name: Vito Bin
source: Vito is an athletic man with a vicious tongue, who is also a fencer. He likes to bully the heroine, however at the same time he takes good care of her. He shows he cares through his peculiar attitude. He seems to do everything he can so that the heroine won't recall the past...
